# selectors

Document and style selectors (Selectors 4, CSS Shadow Parts, CSS Scoping)
are parsed and matched by the unmodified `selectors` 0.43.0 crate from
https://github.com/servo/stylo, under MPL-2.0. `LICENSE` contains its
license. Source is available from that repository and
https://crates.io/crates/selectors/0.43.0. og's own meanings (its
pseudo-classes, its element trees and the parts of its built-in controls)
are in `crates/og-ui/src/doc/selectors.rs` and `crates/og-ui/src/doc/matching.rs`.
